name: Miracle Heart
source:
Natsuki is a boy who transforms when he is kissed by someone he loves.
The protagonist returns to the town where he spent his childhood, and on his first day at his new school, he gets into a scuffle with Natsuki, the student council president, and they accidentally kiss. Natsuki then transforms into Natsumi, a boy the protagonist had loved since childhood. The shy Natsumi had been transformed into the confident Natsuki by the power of a drug the protagonist had given him in the past. The protagonist tries to change him back to Natsumi, but Natsuki won't let him kiss him. To make matters worse, the vice-president, who Natsuki likes, also gets in the way. The protagonist's love has a difficult future. What will happen?

The scenario was written by Kyoo Yamaguchi, winner of the Boys Magazine Novel Award, and the illustrations are by Kinako Fuzuki, making this a high-quality, authentic boys' love story.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071228194402/http://aquahouse.co.jp/marine/miracle/story-syoukai.htmll]webarchive aquahouse[/url]]
translation:
Natsuki是一个被自己所爱之人亲吻后便会变身的少年。
主人公回到童年生活过的小镇。转入新学校第一天，他便与学生会长Natsuki发生争执，两人意外接吻。Natsuki随即变成Natsumi——主人公自幼喜欢的少年。害羞的Natsumi过去服下主人公送给他的药，才变成了自信的Natsuki。主人公试图让他变回Natsumi，Natsuki却不肯让他亲吻。更糟的是，Natsuki喜欢的副会长也来从中作梗。主人公的恋情前途多舛，最终会怎样？

剧本由Boys Magazine Novel Award得主山口恭创作，插画则由藤月きなこ负责，带来一段高质量的正统男同性恋爱情故事。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071228194402/http://aquahouse.co.jp/marine/miracle/story-syoukai.htmll]Web Archive上的Aquahouse页面[/url]]
